page.title: Care pathway
page.intro: These are the care steps. You can ask for counselling from here.
page.notReplacement: This page does not replace a qualified genetic counsellor. It shows the existing pathway and how to reach a person.

when.heading: When a qualified counsellor may help
when.lead: A counsellor can sit with a result, a hard question, or a referral. This page is the path to that person.

result.title: After a result
result.body: A counsellor can explain what a result can and cannot say, including limits and next clinical steps.

question.title: When a question is hard
question.body: Ask routes questions that need a person to Care. Distress, diagnosis, and decisions belong with a counsellor.

share.title: When you choose to share
share.body: A referral can be sent only after clinic share is on. Privacy holds that switch.

empty: No pathway is available for this session.
error: The care pathway could not be loaded.

steps.confirmatory_assessment: Confirmatory assessment (if advised by a counsellor)

send.label: Counselling request
send.lead: This uses the existing referral request. Clinic share must be on first.
send.action: Send my questions and what I understood to the counsellor
send.needsShare: This stays off until clinic share is on.
send.failed: The request could not be sent.

booking.label: Booking
booking.localOnly: Choosing a time stays on this device.
booking.demo: This calendar is a local demonstration. It does not book a clinic appointment.

next.heading: Next steps
next.lead: Ask can send a question. Privacy holds clinic share. Learn holds the education topics.
